aspect: Armenia - the criterion was place of birth
description: Iranian citizens found accounts frozen, with banks across the country applying policies affecting all clients listing Iran as place of birth, regardless of ethnicity or current citizenship.
energy_note: Closed for a line on a birth certificate.

aspect: Georgia - the visa-free country that stopped banking you
description: Georgia waived visas for Iranians from 2011 and became one of the few accessible destinations. The Iran-Georgia Chamber of Commerce reported accounts closed and banks tightening account-opening rules for Iranian citizens.
energy_note: Welcome to enter. Not to hold money.

aspect: UAE - banks acting on their own initiative
description: Emirati banks blocked the accounts of roughly 400 Iranian companies over a period of weeks and refused to open accounts even for dual nationals. Reporting notes these limits were not officially mandated by the governments - the lenders initiated them.
energy_note: Nobody ordered it. It happened anyway.

aspect: It reaches citizens of the destination country too
description: A 2024 FinCEN comment from the National Iranian American Council documented Bank of America identifying as many as 15,000 accounts connected to people of Iranian heritage that had been restricted, and described the problem as systemic across the sector, including Wells Fargo de-risking affecting hundreds of customers.
energy_note: A US citizen, de-banked for a grandparent.

aspect: There is no appeal, because there is no accusation
description: A closure letter gives no reason, because giving one may constitute tipping off. The customer cannot rebut a case that was never stated, and every subsequent bank sees a closed account.
energy_note: Convicted with no charge, no court, and a permanent record.

aspect: The psychological content is specific: it is being treated as contaminated
description: Not accused of anything, not charged, simply not worth the risk. People describe it as being told they are a hazardous material rather than a person.
energy_note: Not guilty. Just not worth the paperwork.

aspect: SCENARIO - the salary that will not land
description: He teaches at a university in Yerevan. In week three the bank calls, politely, to say the account is being closed under policy. His employer cannot pay him in cash. His landlord takes bank transfer only.

aspect: SECONDARY - it teaches the whole family to expect exclusion
description: Children watch a parent be refused, repeatedly, for nothing. The lesson learned is that institutions are not for them, and that lesson persists into a generation with different passports.
